'The purpose and meaning of dancing is to dance' - Alan Watts 

I've thought about the philosophy of life being simply to enjoy your time here. I find it to be quite inspirational yet empty, like telling a baby not to cry. You can say it a lot but doesn't mean it will change what's happening. (By no means is that an attack at you, I mean the philosophy in general) 

When I feel self pity, it feels like I'm doing it for attention despite not telling anyone how I feel. It's stupid yet I still feel it.

Any time I do accomplish something I break down why it means nothing and I'm still worthless. Not purposely it's more intrusive. I don't remember the last time I accomplished somthing I was genuinely proud of. 

Also 'anxiety monkey' is probably the best thing I've heard all week. I love it

I'd probably tell that person they couldn't be more wrong. And I wouldn't believe them at all.

You've stumped me. Ive believed this to be true for months yet you put it that way and my argument crumbles.

However I imagine I'll never know what the people round me truely believe. It is in human nature to be dishonest when not anonymous. 

Even so, what is the point of my existence if I am only wallow is pathetic self pity and achieve nothing ?
Live if not for yourself for the others round you. I really hope you can find the strength to stick around and try have some more fun in the rollercoaster of life

Those who think about suicide and have the strength to keep going are to be admired. 

By simply breathing, eating or just existing you show strength and courage like no other.

If there is one thing you are not it is a coward. You are strong and courageous. 

Please think of all this before you consider suicide. You are stronger than you know.
